title: ServerRequestContext can not be used as parameter of ServerExceptionMapper
body:
### Describe the bug

The documentation for `ServerExceptionMapper` https://quarkus.io/guides/rest#exception-mapping states:
> Your exception mapper may declare any of the following parameter types:
> [...}
> Any of the [Context objects](https://quarkus.io/guides/rest#context-objects)

The list of context objects also includes the [ServerRequestContext](https://javadoc.io/doc/io.quarkus.resteasy.reactive/resteasy-reactive/3.21.2/org/jboss/resteasy/reactive/server/spi/ServerRequestContext.html).

When I want to use the ServerRequestContext as method parameter, I get an exception on startup, see below.

fails:
```
    @ServerExceptionMapper
    RestResponse<String> handle(RuntimeException e, ServerRequestContext serverRequestContext) {
        return RestResponse.ok(serverRequestContext.getRequestHeaders().getRequestHeaders().toString());
    }
```

It works perfectly if I instead use an `@Inject`:
 ```
    @Inject
    ServerRequestContext serverRequestContext;

    @ServerExceptionMapper
    RestResponse<String> handle(RuntimeException e) {
        return RestResponse.ok(serverRequestContext.getRequestHeaders().getRequestHeaders().toString());
    }
```

### Expected behavior

I can use any of the context objects https://quarkus.io/guides/rest#context-objects as method parameter; Since that is what the doc says.
